bio_md:
# 明仁宗朱高炽 · 主要事迹

朱高炽（1378—1425），[[ming-cheng-zu|成祖]]长子，性仁厚，成祖北征时多次监国。永乐二十二年（1424）成祖崩于榆木川，高炽即位，改元洪熙。

仁宗即位即施仁政：罢西洋宝船、减赋役、赦建文旧臣，起用杨士奇等，朝野归心。惜在位仅十月而崩，年四十八。

仁宗之政虽短，其宽仁之基为「仁宣之治」所承。史称「洪熙宣德，庶几仁宗之政」，为明前期最安定的岁月。

bio_parts_en.value:
, was mild by nature and often regent during his father's northern campaigns. When Chengzu died at Yumuchuan in 1424, Gaochi took the throne, era Hongxi.

He opened with benevolence: the western voyages were halted, taxes lightened, the Jianwen loyalists pardoned, Yang Shiqi and others called to office - the realm settled. He reigned only ten months, dying at forty-eight.

Brief as it was, his benevolence underlay the Ren-Xuan peace, the most tranquil years of early Ming.
